summary_en: FY27 (year ending March 2027) annual dividend raised to ¥170/share from ¥150/share, with Q2 interim and full-year dividends each increased from ¥75 to ¥85/share. Connected dividend ratio (DOE) target set at 4.3% for FY27, on path toward 4.5%+ DOE by 2029 under progressive dividend policy. Earnings forecast also upgraded.
title_en: Notice on Upward Revision of FY2027 Second Quarter and Full-Year Consolidated Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief: Ryoden Corporation announced upward revisions to its FY2027 (year ending March 31, 2027) earnings and dividend forecasts on July 28, 2026. The full-year consolidated dividend has been increased to ¥170/share from the previous forecast of ¥150/share, with both the interim (Q2 end) and year-end dividends each raised from ¥75 to ¥85/share. The connected dividend ratio (DOE) for FY27 is set at 4.3%, as the company pursues a progressive dividend policy with a target DOE of 4.5% or higher during the medium-term business plan period (FY2025–2029). The company stated that its shareholder return policy prioritizes stable, long-term capital returns over short-term earnings volatility while maintaining financial soundness and supporting growth investment. The revision reflects stronger operational performance: FA systems market recovery faster than expected with strong order intake; electronics segment benefiting from surging global data-center demand and memory supply constraints driving higher unit prices; and HVAC building systems expanding sales of energy-efficient solutions in response to summer heat demand.
